notes.title: Pull your holster up and load your weapons, the BlackPowder adventure continues
notes.content:
Howdy Folks!

Today we present the first part of our news series about our work on "[b]Black Powder[/b]" in the last few months, to you.
You'll go from the glowing deserts of Arizona, to the fertile landscapes of North Dakota, to the hidden underworlds of "Black Powder".
Load your lead-spitting "life insurance" one last time and set off on a journey of discovery. Always be ready to pull faster than the ruthless enemy ...

[previewyoutube=Bv-M5tNhsno;full][/previewyoutube]

A birds eye view of our map "Abandoned Farm", set in 1868 Arizona. However, everything above the ground isn't all there is to discover.

[previewyoutube=YgCeDvGkAd8][/previewyoutube]

When you've got the guts, descend with us into the mighty catacombs under the abandoned farm of Jessie's brutally smuggled grandparents ...
Explore the countless corridors and rooms whilst you try to survive against your enemies, who are lurking around every corner ... But your enemies aren't the only thing wanting to end your life with a bloody end. There are other dangers lurking deep down ...

[previewyoutube=rk8HStDwwe4;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=JMt0MFnx1bw;full][/previewyoutube]

Enjoy the fertile North Dakota countryside in and around the town of McKenzie in 1870.
Rolling hills, wooded areas, the city of McKenzie and its train station, as well as farms and cultivated arable land await you. But don't be fooled, even here cruel death lurks around every corner, just in a different guise...


[previewyoutube=ZSxeK6iTtOE;full][/previewyoutube]

Join us in the town of Ash Springs, the first stop for Jessie and his companions after the slaughter on the abandoned farm. The streets and alleys of this small town in the steppe of Nevada have given Jessies arch enemy refuge. With Jessies arrival the city is now transformed into a hell of powder, fire, powerful explosions and unspeakable suffering ...
Always orientate yourself with the main street that we show here, it could possibly save your life!


[h3]"Architecture in Black Powder"[/h3]
We will introduce the various buildings that await you in-game, in detail. We start with 4 work-in-progress versions of the models, in the next few episodes these same models will be presented textured and equipped. Have fun watching! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32765470/5f271dc30ef1728b61d52c143df36267832fceb5.png[/img]
A two-story townhouse with very unusual architecture on the upper floor and in the roof area. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32765470/b64395a7ce22e2914259e90f6ead29549e2b5712.png[/img]
A small, wooden semi-detached house as you can see it in many small towns and in the country.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32765470/5c180e4543deee7f9f80f48dae1aad37cf9ee27a.png[/img]
Your local weapons dealer in a fancy townhouse, death may have many calibers but always the same price: Your life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32765470/831f535b52778929971561b4f6172b9cea2572fb.png[/img]
A big, two-storey townhouse – A classical timber construction of its time with an extensive balcony surrounding it. 


We hope you enjoyed the first part of our journey and made it through without any serious injuries ...
Load up your lead syringes, put your holster down and maybe enjoy a last cigarette before continuing with the dangerous discovery of the world of "Black Powder"!

notes.title: #2 Winter in the Wild West - Level Design Of "Cranks Station" 1871
notes.content:
In our last post we showed you the construction of the winter based map, [b]Cranks Station[/b]. 
Today we present you with different content, consisting of in-game images and a small video.
Enjoy the gripping, [b]wintry atmosphere[/b] of the map, captured in the images.
Dress warmly for the ice-cold wind that will pierce your skin.
Snowstorms and subzero temperatures await you and [b]your battered body[/b].

[previewyoutube=AA8Bz_LmBik;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]

[*]     Realistic Ballistics with bullet penetration, ricochets and bullet drop.

notes.title: Winter in the Wild West - Level Design Of "Cranks Station" 1871
notes.content:
It is the year 1871, the next episode of the drama about Jessie's bloody revenge takes place during  the snow-covered winter of 1871/72 in the Appalachian Mountains. Cranks is a small town that has developed little by little around its once lonely train station. Today, in 1871, Cranks is a vibrant little town with everything you need to live and have fun. From saloons, stores and various smaller companies, to the railway depot of a large railway company, everything you need in the west can be found here. Here, a careless "wanna-be hero" can suffer the fate of an unnatural death faster than he would like ...

Be warned stranger, the peaceful appearance of this cozy town is deceptive. Death will be your constant companion!


[previewyoutube=4pDD_3rUvjc;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Please note that the above video is a visualization with no color information yet. The final product and future posts will show the level with true colors.[/i]

The maps in Black Powder are fictional locations that could have existed in the wild west based on historical models. By creating all 3D models based on original templates such as historical photos and sketches, we are able to capture the breathtaking atmosphere of the time with all its facets. The design of fictional locations allows the level design to be flexibly adapted to the requirements of the gameplay of the different maps.

[list]
[*] All buildings are accessible!
[*] Individual, detailed interior design of the building!
[*] Climb on roofs!
[*] Fight in short distances in and around buildings!
[*] Kill your opponents with targeted shots from afar!
[*] Find good shooting positions!
[*] Fight as a team!
[*] Win together!
[/list]

notes.title: Gameplay Mechanics Series | #2 Weapon Sway
notes.content:
During a frantic shootout, the shooter's steady hand is the decisive variable between life and death.

Whether one fires a perfectly aimed, fatal shot depends on several elements that must coincide in the best possible way in the final moment.

It is important to consider the weapons and their individual characteristics such as center of gravity and the presence of shoulder support, as well as the characters own degree of exhaustion and concentration in tense situations or under fire.
The gun sway mechanics in Black Powder allow the player to be immersed in an even more intense experience of firing black powder weapons in the wild west.

The realistic weapon handling in Black Powder is of the utmost importance to us, but we are aware that it is important for a competitive first person shooter that the individual skill of the player must not be negatively affected and/or obstructed by a random, unpredictable aiming mechanic.

[previewyoutube=t969h2XAZUA;full][/previewyoutube]
A Rhodenea curve generates complex patterns that are tailored to the respective weapons. The resulting natural movement of the weapon in the First Person view repeats, allowing a weapon to develop an individual character. This also allows players to learn and master specific guns.

notes.title: Gameplay Mechanics Series | #1 Free Aim
notes.content:
In this upcoming video series we would like to show you a selection of Black Powders features the team has been working tirelessly on. Furthermore we would like to give you a sneak peak into the background works and the resulting gameplay mechanics.


[previewyoutube=sTCbOaQvC5Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Most modern FPS games opt for the aiming mode in which the gun is locked to the character view. They also have the crosshair in the centre of the screen along with the iron sights always aligning to the centre. 

For Black Powder we are allowing the gun to move freely on the players screen within an area, meaning the middle of the screen will not always be the place your gun is aiming. By doing this we don't only replicate eyes, but we also achieve a clearly immersive and natural weapon movement.

[previewyoutube=I5cR-on2P6g;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Black Powder | Tech Insight
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FtTrAKEiWEw

As part of today's technical showcase video, we‘d like to present the making of the „Smoky Mountains“ map to you.

The scenario is set in spring 1872 in the dense woodlands of the Great Smoky Mountains, Tennessee.

Located in a valley, one can spot the settlements of Dudley Lake and Goldwater, separated by one of the many smaller lakes in this region.

The mountains are honeycombed with mine shafts, wild animals roving around in the woods and
those who are brave enough cross the lake on a wild ride in one of the cable cars or rowboats.
With this short video, we would like to give you some insights on how we‘re making use of the Unreal
Engine 4 to create a realistic and natural gaming experience.


This includes:

- Working with 3D landscape materials (DirectX 11 Tessellation)
- Working with the Foliage Tool and Assets
- Setting up weather effects
- Lighting the scene
- Post-processing such as color grading
- Bringing all the visual aspects together to create a coherent atmosphere

We hope that we can provide you with a small, interesting insight into our work.
